feedback.title: UI freezes after ~40 seconds of high-throughput trace streaming
feedback.description: When tailing the ap-south-1 node at >500 logs/sec, the DOM grows unbounded and the browser tab becomes unresponsive.
feedback.leadNote: Reproduced. Switching log table to virtualized windowing in v0.2.1-alpha.

feedback.title: Submit button stays disabled if user pastes OTP instead of typing
feedback.description: Pasting the 6-digit OTP into the first box populates all fields visually, but the form state doesn't enable the Confirm button until a keyup event fires.

feedback.title: Add copy-as-cURL button on API playground code blocks
feedback.description: Would save QA engineers a lot of time when reproducing endpoint calls locally.
